groups: decay ordinary weights; no decay normalization parameters or biases; no backbone LR multiplier; no automatic batch scaling
scheduler: 300 linear warmup then cosine to .01 at9000; successful updates; fixed prefix

loss.reduction: native YOLO batch-scaled loss vector sum; sum across accumulation microbatches without additional division

preprocessing: RGB PIL bilinear direct 960x960 stretch; float32 /255; no normalization, no padding, no letterbox
sampler: same stateless uniform repeating permutations as current RT-DETR reference; consumed full microbatch cursor; deterministic transforms

evaluation.primary: arithmetic mean of clean and all five domain APs; percentage points

checkpoint_selection: Final EMA at exactly 5500 successful optimizer updates; no best-validation selection

amp_scaler.overflow: No successful-update increment on skipped optimizer step; preserve installed scaler behavior
amp_scaler.nonfinite_forward: Hold affected job; do not skip/relabel failed batch

ciou_precision: Regression CIoU geometric arithmetic FP32, both boxes explicitly cast, autocast disabled only for geometry; native autograd/formula/alpha stop-gradient unchanged; all other loss and assignment settings unchanged
